tiers.name: Foundation
tiers.narrative: Every expert starts here. You're building the mental models that separate confident practitioners from confused button-clickers.
tiers.celebration: You've built a solid foundation! You understand AI, you can think in processes, and you've built your first workflow.

tiers.name: Builder
tiers.narrative: You understand the concepts. Now you'll prove it by building real workflows that solve real problems.
tiers.celebration: You're a certified builder! You can create multi-step, advanced workflows with professional output.

tiers.name: Architect
tiers.narrative: You're not just using the tool — you're designing systems. This is where practitioners become leaders.
tiers.celebration: You've earned your certification! You can design, validate, scale, and govern AI workflows.
